text.content:
Cat ears, an Arasaka name, and a grudge.

Role: CEO, Danger Gal; detective
Affiliation: Danger Gal; Puma Squad codename Calico
Where to find them: The Bridgehead, 13th–14th floors; Lizzie's Bar
Known for: Taking Danger Gal from her mother in 2070; proving the Claws killed Lizzie Borden

Michiko's daughter, born in 2027. Her birth record names the man Kei Arasaka had promised Michiko to, a name that appears in no other record; Night City's rumor names Adam Smasher, and she has never denied it. She grew up in the Danger Zone, voiced Kitten in the Puma Squad cartoon at seven, and was kidnapped on her way home from school at eighteen, in late 2045. Three days later she walked into the lobby unhurt, with a crew of edgerunners on their first job.

Her mother gave her a mentor, the detective Walkson, and she was a Puma, codename Calico, at nineteen. In her thirties she ran Danger Gal's smallest office, one room above Shen's Noodles in Kabuki, taking the cases nobody else would; in 2067 she proved the Claws killed Lizzie Borden and gave the Mox the evidence free.

When Michiko went home to Arasaka, Minako refused to let Danger Gal go with her, and won. She took the chair in spring 2070 with no money, half the staff in NUSA detention and the headquarters signed over to Arasaka; bought the Bridgehead with money borrowed from the Mox; registered under her birth name; and mounted a neon cat's eye on the north face to stare at the Waterfront. "Mother's watching the city. I'm watching Mother."

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05; Danger Gal Dossier
